note: Documented flooding at day resolution only; no hour-level public timeline was found. Times are IST.

facts.text: Torrential rain from the weekend of 2-3 December continued until Tuesday 5 December.
Velachery bore the brunt of the deluge on Monday 4 December; Pallikaranai among the affected suburbs.
Velachery, Pallikaranai and surroundings still heavily waterlogged on 5 December; waterlogging persisted on 7 December.
Sphere India situation report 1 on Cyclone Michaung, 4 December 2023.
Chennai city received more than 30 cm of rainfall on 1 December 2015.
Corporation officials say they were informed of the 29,000 cusecs release at about 8 pm on 1 December; a petitioner told the High Court the flood warning was issued only at midnight.
The city flooded on 2 December after the release of 29,000 cusecs from Chembarambakkam into the Adyar.
